fr_html: Le PRESIDENT doute que les gouvernements, au milieu des influences multiples qui les assailent, tiennent toujours compte du résultat de ces consultations.
en_html: The PRESIDENT doubted whether governments, surrounded as they are by many different influences, would always take into account the results of such consultations.
